document_notes: Page 171 of PIR contains entry 883, which is highly relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus due to the explicit attestation of the governorship of Thracia.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly attested as 'Legatus Augusti pr. pr. Thraciae' under Antoninus Pius in the year 140.

segments.name_variants: M. Antonius Zeno, M. A[vtwviog Ζήνων], [M. An]- tonius Zeno, Avr. Ζήνων, Ζήνων
segments.identification_and_sources: Nummi: 1) Perinthi in parte aversa ἐπὶ Avr. Ζήνωνος πρ(εσβευτοῦ) LeB(actod) ἀντ(ιστρατήγου) ΠΠερινθίων, in adversa a) θεὰ Φαυστεῖνα b) Αὐρήλιος Οὐῆρος Καῖσαρ... 2) Philippopolis... 3) Nicopolis... Consulatus eius commemoratur in dipl. mil. III p. 1985 = D. 2005 (1). — Ad hunc refertur t. mutilus Serdicensis Kalinka Ant. Denkm. in Bulg. p. 22 n. 26 = IGR 1, 1454... idem memorari videtur in fragmento tituli Thuggensis VIII 1480 cf. p. 2616 (3).
segments.offices_and_career: consul (suffectus) a. 148. Legatus Augusti pr. pr. Thraciae imperante Antonino Pio... Proc[onsul Africae]... quinto decimo fere anno post consulatum.
segments.governorship_attestation: Legatus Augusti pr. pr. Thraciae imperante Antonino Pio nummi, anno 140 i. 2; nummos Perinthiorum cum in- scriptione θεὰ Φαυστεῖνα post morlem Faustinae Augustae i. e. non ante a. 140 cusos esse censuit Kubitschek Num. Ztschr. 44, 1911, 155.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Ex posteris videtur eius qui praecedit [882]. Idem videtur M. Antonius Zeno, maritus Antiae Marcellinae, quae posuit t. urbanum VI 36 848; Zenonis et Marcellinae filius nescio an fuerit M. Antonius Antius Lupus (n. 812).
segments.prosopographical_commentary: The entry discusses the identification of the governor of Thrace with the consul of 148 and the proconsul of Africa, as well as his family connections.
segments.bibliography_or_cross_references: Stein Thracia p. 19; Imhoof-Blumer Monn. gr. p. 44; Br. Mus. Thracia p. 161; Ant. Münz. Nordgriech. 1, 1 p. 349; Kubitschek Num. Ztschr. 44, 1911, 155.
